<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/shipping">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Invitation" name="Invitation to make an offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offer" name="Shipping offer"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shipping" name="Prepare goods for shipment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Shipment decision needed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_To_ShippingDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShippingDecision" name="Goods to be shipped?" default="Flow_ShippingDecision_No">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_To_ShippingDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShippingDecision_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShippingDecision_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClarifyShipping" name="Secretary clarifies who will do the shipping">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShippingDecision_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Clarify_To_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Begin preparation in parallel">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Clarify_To_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_ShippingRoute</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_PackGoods</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_Label</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_InsuranceDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AmountDecision" name="Large amount?" default="Flow_Amount_Small">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_ShippingRoute</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Amount_Large</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Amount_Small</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InviteCompanies" name="Secretary invites three logistics companies to make offers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Amount_Large</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Invite_To_ReceiveOffers</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive offers from the logistics companies" messageRef="Message_Offer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Invite_To_ReceiveOffers</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Offers_To_SelectCompany</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCompany" name="Secretary selects one logistics company">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Offers_To_SelectCompany</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_To_RouteMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_NormalPost" name="Use normal post shipment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Amount_Small</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Post_To_RouteMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RouteMerge" name="Shipping route determined">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_To_RouteMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Post_To_RouteMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RouteMerge_To_PreparationJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackageGoods" name="Warehousemen package the goods">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_PackGoods</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PackGoods_To_PreparationJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteLabel" name="Secretary writes a package label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_Label</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Label_To_PreparationJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsuranceDecision" name="Is parcel insurance necessary?" default="Flow_Insurance_No">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_InsuranceDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Insurance_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Insurance_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeInsurance" name="Logistics department head takes out parcel insurance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Insurance_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsuranceYes_To_InsuranceMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsuranceMerge" name="Insurance decision complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsuranceYes_To_InsuranceMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsuranceNo_To_InsuranceMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsuranceMerge_To_PreparationJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="All preparation complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RouteMerge_To_PreparationJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PackGoods_To_PreparationJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Label_To_PreparationJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsuranceMerge_To_PreparationJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PreparationJoin_To_Pickup</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePickup" name="Prepare packaged goods for pickup by the logistics company">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PreparationJoin_To_Pickup</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Pickup_To_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup" name="Goods prepared for pickup">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Pickup_To_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoShipment" name="No shipment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShippingDecision_No</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_To_ShippingDecision" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShippingDecision_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingDecision" targetRef="Task_ClarifyShipping">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">goodsShallBeShipped</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShippingDecision_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_NoShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Clarify_To_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyShipping" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_ShippingRoute" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AmountDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_PackGoods" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PackageGoods"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Label" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_WriteLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_InsuranceDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Amount_Large" name="Large amount" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountDecision" targetRef="Task_InviteCompanies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">amountIsLarge</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invite_To_ReceiveOffers" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offers_To_SelectCompany" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_SelectCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_To_RouteMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectCompany" targetRef="Gateway_RouteMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Amount_Small" name="Small amount" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountDecision" targetRef="Task_NormalPost"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Post_To_RouteMerge" sourceRef="Task_NormalPost" targetRef="Gateway_RouteMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RouteMerge_To_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_RouteMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackGoods_To_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Label_To_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_WriteLabel" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceDecision" targetRef="Task_TakeInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insuranceIsNecessary</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceYes_To_InsuranceMerge" sourceRef="Task_TakeInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceDecision" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceNo_To_InsuranceMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceDecision" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceMerge_To_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationJoin_To_Pickup" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_PreparePickup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pickup_To_End" sourceRef="Task_PreparePickup" targetRef="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Shipping">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ShippingProcess" name="Shipping preparation" processRef="Process_Shipping"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticsCompanies" name="Three logistics companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitation" name="Invitations" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Participant_LogisticsCompanies" messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Offers" sourceRef="Participant_LogisticsCompanies" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
